central_findings: The September 24 H-v2 package is the author-labeled final empirical version: 1.025 rooms, SE 0.073; its target horizon remains pending.

The 1.465 paired-run instruction was authorized for the experimental calibration and its frozen run/target must remain intact. The report makes no post-authorization revocation claim; future empirical/model target adoption is a separate decision.

The existing model observer is an aggregate one-period forced-birth-versus-held-childless branch contrast; saved lunch outputs do not contain respondent-level histories for the empirical event-study estimator.

A symmetric education-free, four-year-age-cell empirical bridge is proposed because the active model has no education state. It is auxiliary, not the original 1.025 H coefficient and not an automatic replacement.

A small four-year date/age-cell observer component is implemented and tested on Torch; it explicitly rejects ages above the model’s 82-year support. Full empirical bridge and model-history measurements remain unrun pending lead review of sample support and proposed budget.
